summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 (no code changes made — audit only)  **Bottom line: I could not find the bug described in the ticket.** I traced the full path (client → fetch layer → auth middleware → handlers → DB schema) and also ran a live repro (signup → create list → logout → login again) against the current `master`. The watchlist persisted correctly across the login cycle, with correct per-user isolation. The three failure modes named in the ticket — missing `X-User-Id` on save, a hardcoded/anonymous watchlist id on the client, missing `credentials: 'include'` — are all absent f
